description: A link-styled trigger that opens a floating drawer with a quick preview, such as a profile card.
overview:
`PreviewTrigger` renders inline in link color and dims when pressed. It opens a `Drawer` that floats above the screen edges by default and has a swipe handle.

Use it to show a summary of a person, place or item from a mention or link without leaving the screen.
usage:
Put a `PreviewTrigger` and a `PreviewContent` inside `Preview`. A string or number child of the trigger is wrapped in `Text`.

The preview can be uncontrolled or controlled with `open`, `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange`. `PreviewContent` pads its children and adds end padding when a close button is shown, so content does not sit under it.

examples.OpenByDefault: Opens the preview on first render.
examples.Attached: Sets `floating` to `false` so the drawer sits on the screen edges.

parts.Preview: The root drawer, floating by default.
parts.PreviewTrigger: The link-styled element that opens the preview.
parts.PreviewContent: The drawer content with padding for the preview.

Preview.open: Controls whether the preview is open.
Preview.defaultOpen: Whether the preview starts open when uncontrolled.
Preview.onOpenChange: Called when the preview opens or closes.
Preview.floating: Insets the drawer from the screen edges. Defaults to `true`.

PreviewContent.closeLabel: Label of the close button; adds more end padding when set.

accessibility: - Give `PreviewContent` an `accessibilityLabel` that names what is previewed.
